description.value: This study examines longitudinal changes in noun concreteness in patients with semantic variant primary progressive aphasia and relates those changes to longitudinal MRI measures of gray matter.

spans.text: This study examines longitudinal changes in the concreteness of nouns produced by human patients with semantic variant primary progressive aphasia (svPPA).
